Description.SourceString: 在<blue>操场</>制止<blue>「龙卷风」</>，随后前往<blue>食堂</>
Description.LocalizedString: Stop <blue>Tornado</> at the <blue>playground</>, then go to the <blue>Cafeteria</>.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 在拘留所<blue>下午放风时间</>，制止<blue>操场</>上的<blue>「龙卷风」</>欺凌弱小。随后，在<blue>食堂</>，与你结下梁子的<blue>「旋风帮」</>成员们不怀好意地围堵过来……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: During <blue>Afternoon Break Time</> at the Detention Facility, stop <blue>Tornado</> from bullying weaker detainees on the <blue>playground</>. Later, in the <blue>Cafeteria</>, the <blue>Tornado Gang</> members you crossed earlier close in with trouble on their minds…

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>图书馆</>寻找线索
Description.LocalizedString: Search for clues in the <blue>Library</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 图书馆中应该有记载拘留所地下结构的文件，找找看吧。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The Library should have records of the Detention Facility's underground structure. Search for clues there.

Description.SourceString: 在<blue>浴室</>寻找线索
Description.LocalizedString: Search for clues in the <blue>Bathroom</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「旋风帮」成员身上的特殊异味指引你找到一处浴室。这里究竟藏着什么秘密？
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: The strange odor on the Tornado Gang members leads you to a bathroom. What secret is hidden here?

Description.SourceString: 战胜「旋风帮」
Description.LocalizedString: Defeat the Tornado Gang.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 终于找到了「旋风帮」成员的秘密据点。从现在起，轮到你反击了。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: You've finally found the Tornado Gang's secret hideout. From now on, it's your turn to strike back.

Description.SourceString: 战胜「龙卷风」
Description.LocalizedString: Defeat Tornado

PanelDescription.SourceString: 向「龙卷风」，发起挑战。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Challenge Tornado.

Description.SourceString: 宣布「旋风帮」的新规则
Description.LocalizedString: Announce the Tornado Gang's new rules.

PanelDescription.SourceString: 击败「龙卷风」后，你成为了「旋风帮」的新任领袖。现在，众人都等待着你这位新任「龙卷风」会立下怎样的规矩。
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: With Tornado defeated, you have become the Tornado Gang's new leader. Now, all eyes are on you to see what rules the new Tornado will lay down.

Description.SourceString: 前往了解<blue>「方程式驾校」</>
Description.LocalizedString: Go learn about <blue>Formula Driving School</>

PanelDescription.SourceString: 「方程式驾校」火热招生中，只有前一百位幸运儿可以免费体验！真的靠谱吗……
PanelDescription.LocalizedString: Formula Driving School is now accepting students! The first 100 lucky applicants can try a lesson for free. Is this for real…?
